evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Missing entirely. Rep launches into pricing discussion without the time-boxed framing or 'does that sound good to you?' wait.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep never asks 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full estimate provided: '$7,990' for Thursday packing + Friday move, or '$7,738' for Wednesday packing + Thursday move, with crew size (4 guys packing, 6 guys + 3 trucks moving) and hourly rates ($97 weekday, $103 Fri/Sat). Includes materials ($450-$560 for boxes).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep covers: 'we do not have any additional fees. You know we don't have anything like a fuel fee, no disassemble reassembly fees, no hidden fees at all' and '2.5 hour minimum' and 'prorate every fifteen minutes.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. No 'does that feel fair?' check.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never explicitly asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Rep instead moves directly to scheduling once customer says 'that sounds good.' Customer initiates: 'I'd like to get it scheduled.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date confirmed (October 22 packing, October 23 move); time window confirmed (8:30-9:00 am); addresses, phone, payment method mentioned; no crew size or notes confirmed for the move itself.

top_strength: Jules clearly explained the two-day packing/moving split with specific crew sizes and pricing for both day-of-week options, and successfully locked in the customer's preferred dates with near-complete booking details.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire discovery phase—no quid pro quo framing in Section 1, no 'what are your biggest concerns' in Section 2, no two-promise delivery in Section 5, and no final concerns check in Section 6; the customer initiated the ask instead of Jules making it, and neither On-Time nor Damage Coverage guarantees were mentioned at all.
